payload.message: Fix request timeout without hiding errors.

## Retry policy

- Bound each retry.
- Keep the original cause.

```go
func retry(ctx context.Context) error {
    return request.WithTimeout(ctx, "https://example.invalid/api/very/long/path/for/terminal/wrapping", 3*time.Second)
}
```
